Attached: 1 image

You don't need to feel disciplined before you start. You need ninety seconds.

Before messages: write your next action in six words or fewer, tie it to something that already happens ("When the kettle clicks, I will write the first paragraph"), then do it for ninety seconds. You're allowed to stop when the timer ends.

Discipline is a skill. Train the next rep, not the identity.

#productivity #habits
